added.body:
Hi Alex,

Here's a summary of the 5 most recent messages in your inbox:

1. Q1 Infrastructure Optimization Summary (from alex@nexusai.com to team@nexusai.com, Jul 14)
   Draft summary of Q1 infrastructure changes. Sent from your own address to the team list.

2. Phoenix launch readiness — open action items (from Priya Sharma, Jul 14)
   Project Phoenix load testing is complete with p99 latency at 240ms (within target). Two open action items remain: rollback runbook sign-off (owned by Priya) and one other item ahead of the launch review.

3. RE: Follow-up call - NexusAI Series A (from Alex Chen to Marcus Tan at a16z, Jul 13)
   Follow-up on scheduling a call with Marcus regarding the Series A. Thursday at 2pm PT was proposed. Topics include go-to-market strategy and technical differentiation. Alex will send a Zoom link.

4. Customer escalation: Meridian Health onboarding blocked (from Tom Castillo, Jul 13)
   Meridian Health's onboarding is blocked due to an SSO integration issue — their IdP sends a non-standard SAML attribute that the mapper rejects. They are a $180k ARR account with go-live scheduled for next week.

5. Q3 infra budget review — Crestline invoice variance (from Dana Whitfield, Jul 13)
   Q3 infra budget review closing out. The Crestline Cloud invoice came in 18% over forecast ($64.2k vs $54.4k), driven by the new GPU pool. All other line items are within 3% of plan.

This draft was prepared for your review. No messages were sent.

— Workspace Assistant
